title: Generate the family uniformly with paid computable arithmetic preprocessing
statement: Finite deterministic enumeration builds a totally real arithmetic field, definite quaternion maximal order, local tables, quotient and valid cubical base. Orbit candidates are effectively bounded by walking-place denominators plus total definiteness. BFS closes by cocompactness. Congruence images at a fixed odd unramified place have adjacent ratio<=Q^4 and order growing at least p^(nu-O(1)), hence nu=O(log|G_nu|). Pullback charts give uniform larger covers; first sufficient dimension has n=O(q).
